message.littleweather.need_overworld: Weather jars only work in the Overworld.
message.littleweather.need_sky: You need open sky above you to catch the weather.
message.littleweather.not_clear: The sky isn't right for this spot. Wait for a clear sky, or for rain that falls here.
message.littleweather.stars_rising: The stars are still coming out. Wait a little longer.
message.littleweather.daytime: Nothing to catch yet. Try during rain, at sunset, or on a clear night.
message.littleweather.wrong_time: The sky is changing. Try again in a moment.
